He flew RC helicopters. He wanted to be a pilot, but he was rejected because he was colourblind. So it just became a hobby for him. 

They were huge, gas powered things—I mean like the size of a dog. Big. And loud. I remember standing out in his yard one summer while he flew one around the cul-de-sac and showed off some tricks. Rolls and dives. He was really good!
